task.title: HealthKit Sleep discovery + canonical architecture (read-only); Founder data shape needs D2 authorization

result.summary: Read-only Sleep architecture: Native already requests Sleep read and has a dormant localOnly stream; Server has no Sleep contract or deletions. Designed sample->episode->wake-date sleep day (18:00 window) canonicalization, episode-level primary-source reconciliation, hourly background sync with activation floor + deletion/window manifest, minimal Evidence UI, privacy allow-list, phases A-E and a 24-case test matrix. Founder data shape not obtainable without a build or Founder action.

tests.summary: Research/architecture only; no code changed. Claims spot-verified against source at Native 71164900 and Server 4a81f5b4 (identical HealthKit files to prod 372c306b).

review.summary: No code to review; architecture awaits ChatGPT/Founder review.

zero_write_audit.summary: No production reads or writes performed.

decisions_required: D1: prospective Sleep start sleep-day D0 (needed before Phase C canary, not before Phase A/B).

D2: Founder data-shape check - Option A 2-minute Health app look (Sleep > Data Sources & Access; stages/In Bed/naps yes-no), and/or authorize an on-device-only diagnostic probe in the next Native build.
D3: whether a bounded 14-night validation_only historical read is wanted solely for UI/design validation (never strategic).
D4: nap presentation (recommended: secondary episodes in night detail, 'Nap' if 09:00-18:00, headline = main sleep).
blockers: Founder Sleep data shape cannot be read without a new Native build or Founder action; stopped per prompt.
unexpected_findings: Native Nutrition observer maps to zero HealthKit sample types, so its background-delivery registration is vacuous (foreground/Activity-wake only).
Per-sample workout uploads send HKSource.name verbatim (Apple Watch device name may contain a personal name); Server stores it as-is.
Native deferredChanges store is append-only; a queried localOnly stream would grow state files unboundedly (not triggered today).
Production Server moved to 372c306b (Codex Photo deploy 4dac1b07) since the last handoff recorded 4a81f5b4; no HealthKit file differences.
backlog: Sleep Phase A (Server dormant contracts + canonicalizer + synthetic tests).
Sleep Phase B (Native dormant read path behind manifest flag).
Fix Nutrition observer type mapping; normalize workout sourceName; bound deferredChanges.
recommended_next_step: Founder answers D2 Option A (no build) and reviews the architecture; then issue the Sleep Phase A Server-dormant implementation prompt in section 17 of the report.
